fonts.display: 'Switzer', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'system-ui sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Champagne Gold
palette.role: Accent headings, category tags, decorative borders — the only chromatic color in the system, used sparingly to mark emphasis and brand-bearing elements

palette.name: Candlelight Cream
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders, icon strokes — warm off-white reads softer than pure white against the black canvas

palette.name: Obsidian Black
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, image backgrounds — absolute black dominates the visual field

palette.name: Ember Ash
palette.role: Muted surface variation, secondary backgrounds, low-emphasis fills
